snippet.title: Mandrake & Wholesome Snack || Meet your furry neighbour, the Yolf
snippet.description:
Wishlist Mandrake on Steam: https://bit.ly/WholesomeMandrake

We were so delighted to be deemed Wholesome by the kind people at Wholesome Games! After 16 years working in a universe where cannibalism is commonplace, Mandrake is a different flavour: a rural life sim where horticulture is cursed, and you'll meet your large and furry - and somewhat mercenary - neighbour, the Yolf.

More about Mandrake
You are the last of the Mandrakes, a sorcerous line of gardeners. At long last, you’ve returned to your family's abandoned home. Make friends, tend your gardens, and put down roots. Fish, gather and delve in the wilds. Make a place for yourself, and uncover the mysteries your family left behind.

Visit www.failbettergames.com to find out more about us. Go to http://bit.ly/FBGNewsletterSignup for our newsletter which is, I'll be honest, mostly not even about video games (how do you feel about weird history, birds, webcomics, and internet ephemera?).
